title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test workflows, upgrade Node to 20, and tighten release automation
author: Marco Liu
release_notes:
- Consolidated CI workflows to reduce duplicate runs and speed up PR feedback.
- Upgraded GitHub Actions jobs to Node 20 and updated dependency matrix.
- Simplified release workflow and tightened tag validation to avoid accidental releases.
- Repo hygiene: removed deprecated scripts, added a CI docs page.
description:
Motivation: Our CI has accumulated a number of repository-specific workflows that run redundant lint/test steps across SDKs and core packages. This led to long queue times and duplicated logs. At the same time, we need to standardize on Node 20 in CI to match runtime expectations and reduce subtle failures caused by version skew. This PR consolidates lint/test workflows into shared templates, upgrades Action runners to Node 20 where applicable, and tightens release automation to reduce accidental tag-based releases.

Summary of changes: Consolidate multiple lint/test jobs into a single matrix-driven workflow that reuses templates for SDKs and core services; upgrade Node from 18 -> 20 in relevant steps; factor common steps into .github/workflows/ci-templates and reference them from per-repo workflows; simplify release workflow to validate tags and require a specific label for automatic publishes; remove legacy scripts under tools/ci that are no longer used.

Checklist: - [x] Confirmed unit/integration matrix coverage matches previous runs (accounting for deduping). - [x] Verified lint rules run in Node 20 produce identical results to Node 18 on sample repos. - [x] Updated CONTRIBUTING and docs/ci.md with new workflow links. - [x] Notified integrators (SDK owners) about slight job name changes.

Commits (high level): - Introduce shared CI templates and matrix orchestration. - Upgrade node-version to 20 in workflow templates. - Add tag validation and label gating to release workflow. - Remove tools/ci/legacy-lint.sh and update references. - Docs: add docs/ci.md and update README.dev.md.

Files changed (high level): .github/workflows/ci.yml (replaced by template includes), .github/workflows/release.yml (tightened validation), .github/workflows/ci-templates/ (new), package.json (ci scripts harmonized), yarn.lock (deps updated), tools/ci/* (cleanup), .eslintrc.js (minor rule normalization), docs/ci.md, README.dev.md.

CI and validation: First CI run failed due to a hard-coded Node 18 reference in a third-party action; fixed by switching to the official setup-node@v4 and re-running. Full CI matrix completed: lint (pass), unit (pass), integration (pass), e2e (flaky tests skipped via known-flaky list). Performance: average queued runtime for PRs reduced by ~22% in internal sampling due to deduping overlapping jobs.

Review discussion (selected highlights): Sofia Ramirez (reviewer): "Can we preserve job names so downstream dashboards keep continuity?" Author (Marco Liu): "Kept top-level job IDs for major SDK jobs; only internal step names changed. Added mapping notes in docs/ci.md." Daniel Kim (reviewer): "Release gating looks good, but add a guard if the tagging action fails to avoid CI promoting a malformed tag." Author: "Added additional tag regex validation and an explicit error message; tested flow locally with dry-run." Priya Nair (reviewer, approval): "LGTM. Verified Node 20 runs against redwood-sdk-python example and no regressions observed."

Merge notes: Squash merge after CI green. Post-merge tasks: open small follow-ups to rename a couple of dashboard references and remove three now-unused action secrets. Communicated change in #infra-notices with rollout notes and links to docs/ci.md for integrators.

Backcompat and migration: Workflows provide backward-compatible matrix entries for repos that explicitly opt into the new templates; we added a one-week auto-migration plan and a fallback label workflow in case teams need more time.
commits: feat(ci): add shared ci templates and matrix orchestration
chore(ci): upgrade actions to node 20 and switch to setup-node@v4
fix(release): validate tags and require 'auto-release' label
docs(ci): add docs/ci.md and update README.dev.md
